verdict.rationale: Mercury's API exposes per-item CRUD endpoints (transactions, customers, invoices, cards) and list operations, plus OAuth2/API-token access explicitly documented for AI agents (llms.txt), enabling scripted bulk actions like creating many virtual cards. However, no evidence of dedicated batch/bulk endpoints (e.g., bulk update, bulk payment) — community evidence shows a user manually created 'hundreds' of cards over time rather than via a single bulk call, and an OpenAPI spec probe returned 404s.
